feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 14 November 2026 5:00am
items.description:
##Today##

Tending to be fairly cloudy today with scattered showers, some of which could be persistent at times, then clearing for the evening. Moderate southwest winds increasing fresh to strong. Maximum temperature of 11°C. Comments: Strong winds developing.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 3°C and max. air temperature 11°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-6


##Wind Speed##

22


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

Southwest 15-20, gradually increasing south or southwest 20-25 by midday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

A band of rain will arrive during the early hours of the morning, remaining persistent and at times heavy through the morning before gradually petering out through the afternoon or evening, leaving a clearer end to the day. Fresh to strong, mainly southwest winds will decrease for a time in the morning before veering northwest, then increase again to become strong with a risk of gales by the evening. Maximum temperature 10°C.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 5°C and max. air temperature 10°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

10-20


##Wind Speed##

22


##Wind Direction##

NW


##Wind##

South or southwest 20-25, decreasing 15-20 through the morning, then veering northwest 20-35 early afternoon. Increasing 25-32 early evening, and perhaps up to 35 with gusts 45 in the evening for a time. Decreasing 15-20 early in the night.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds. Risk of heavy rain. Risk of gales later.


##Monday, 16 November 2026##

Some clear intervals and a few wintry showers overnight. Minimum temperature of 1°C. Mainly dry with bright or sunny spells during the daytime, then cloud thickens early in the night with a band of rain soon arriving. Moderate to fresh northwest winds becoming light and variable for a time during the day, before becoming easterly in the afternoon, then increasing strong later. Top temperature of 8°C.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 2°C and max. air temperature 8°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-6


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

NW


##Wind##

Northwest 15-20, decreasing west 5-10 by midday, then sharply becoming east or southeast in the afternoon. Increasing 25-30 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Comments##

Strong winds later. Risk of frost and ice.


##Tuesday, 17 November 2026##

An area of rain arriving around midnight, continuing persistent and often heavy for much of the day, clearing early in the night. Strong east winds gradually easing from the northeast. Top temperature 8°C.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 1°C and max. air temperature 8°C

10-20


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

E


##Wind##

East 25-30, backing northeast 20-25 in the afternoon, decreasing 15-20 later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds at first.


##Wednesday, 18 November 2026##

Largely dry with bright or sunny spells, only the small risk of the odd isolated shower. Moderate to fresh northeast winds decreasing to become light to moderate. Top temperature 9°C.
